name: dsweave
description: DSWeave — 空间化知识引擎：拖入文件 → Agent 理解 → 产出 3D 沉浸式知识场景

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/protocol packages/agent packages/host && pnpm --filter @dsweave/player build && pnpm --filter @dsweave/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/protocol packages/agent packages/host && pnpm --filter @dsweave/web --filter @dsweave/player exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/protocol packages/agent packages/host && rimraf "packages/*/dist" "packages/*/.tsbuildinfo"
